notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Virtue of Loyalty triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Virtue of Loyalty's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Virtue of Loyalty's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and untapping them.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.
